verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair question for a SaaS work-management platform like ClickUp, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents a Public API, an OpenAPI spec, an MCP server and an in-browser "Try It" panel, but none of it mentions an official command-line tool. These are adjacent developer building blocks and an MCP integration, not a CLI, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
